description.p: AppHarbor gives users one clear, trustworthy place to discover, inspect, and safely remove applications installed through different packaging methods on Linux.

ul.li: Single unified inventory across Flatpak, RPM/DNF, Snap, AppImage, DEB/APT, Pacman, Zypper, and manual desktop entries.
Strict separation of installation source from installation scope (System vs User).
Safe, explicit uninstallation with personal data preservation by default.
Critical system component protection preventing accidental system breakage.
Fault-tolerant discovery architecture where missing or failing tools never block other sources.
Accessible, polished UI adhering strictly to GNOME HIG and Libadwaita standards.
